title: Cache negative results
purpose: Stop paying twice for a lookup that fails, by remembering the failure as well as the success.
applicable_when: the same external lookup is repeated within a task

title: Measure before tuning
purpose: Tuning an unmeasured path is guessing with extra steps.
applicable_when: a change is proposed for performance

title: Prefer rollback over debugging under load
purpose: When a deploy is implicated and users are affected, restoring the last good state buys the time to understand the failure.

title: Bisect the timeline
purpose: When behaviour changed, the change is between the last good and the first bad observation.
applicable_when: a regression has a known-good earlier state

title: Retry without backoff
purpose: Retrying a saturated dependency at full rate turns an outage into a livelock.
corrective_rule: retry with jittered exponential backoff and a hard attempt ceiling
